::: {.text-serif .text-secondary}
A blog on econometrics, spatial statistics, remote sensing, and scientific visualization -- with code samples in <mark>`R, Python, JS`</mark> and <mark>`D3.js`</mark>.

Topics range from sustainable agriculture and food security, to policies for equitable trade, growth and development, and the geopolitics of natural resources.

You will also find book and article reviews, and the occasional shout-out and opinion pieces. 

Check out my [full bio](./posts/resume/index.qmd) for contact details.
:::
:::
